cards.text: Owns the state: worktrees, agents, PRs, CI. Derives every line from facts. No LLM.
cards.title: Engine

cards.text: Claude Code or Codex sessions, one or more per worktree. They work, ask and report.
cards.title: Agents

cards.text: An agent with a mandate: relays, re-runs CI, holds while it verifies. Never merges alone.
cards.title: Orchestrator

cards.text: Answer what blocks an agent, merge, decide. Home shows what needs you first.
cards.title: You

sections.intro: The engine watches. Agents work. The orchestrator helps. You decide.
sections.title: How it fits together

sections.caption: Home: Now, the Round, To sit down with, In flight, and the Parked chip.
sections.intro: One line per work item: a branch with its PR, its agents and its CI. Nothing to keep up to date: the engine derives every line.
sections.title: Home

sections.caption: An expanded line: the whole ask, its buttons, and since you looked.
sections.intro: An inbox line starts with what to do (a verb); an In flight line with who has the ball.
sections.title: Reading a line

sections.intro: Who must move next. Only the ball you sees your inbox.
sections.title: The ball

sections.caption: The decision view: options on the left, evidence on the right.

cards.text: 1-4 pick, Ctrl+Enter answers. It reaches the agent after its turn.
cards.title: Answer

cards.text: y: the owner agent explains in 10 lines; ⇧Y restores it first.
cards.title: Explain this

cards.text: b: ask for a better one, with a note.
cards.title: New brief

sections.intro: A brief is a question with options, a recommendation and evidence. Enter (or v) opens it.
sections.title: Decisions

sections.caption: The park menu: until when, for this item or the whole work item.

cards.text: 1 h, tomorrow, a week, until something changes, indefinitely.
cards.title: Park  z

cards.text: Who has the ball and why: others · QA.
cards.title: Label  l

cards.text: Done or dropped. Never touches the worktree, branch or PR.
cards.title: Close  ⇧X

cards.text: x, z, d and ⇧O show Undo for 5 s (Ctrl+Z).
cards.title: Undo

sections.intro: Keep your inbox to what you can act on today.
sections.title: Park, label, close

sections.caption: The orchestrator strip: its report, its queue, today's actions, presence.

cards.text: Hand it an item for 2 h. It releases it with a note, or hands it back.
cards.title: Pass  ⇧O

cards.text: It holds a worker's branch while it verifies, then releases it to you.
cards.title: Hold

cards.text: Present: small reversible steps. Away: also reversible briefs, rebases, workers.
cards.title: Mandate

cards.text: Merge, publish, force-push, delete unpushed work, close a PR: always yours.
cards.title: Never alone

cards.text: Undo its decision for a day: tells the agent, stops what it spawned.
cards.title: Revert  ⇧U

sections.intro: A delegate with a mandate. The strip on top of Home says what it is doing, what it holds and what it did today.
sections.title: The orchestrator

sections.intro: Each line's state comes from the first rule that matches, top to bottom. An unknown fact never matches.
sections.title: Every state

sections.intro: What can land in your inbox, at which level, and the verb it shows.
sections.title: Inbox items

sections.intro: Single letters act on the selected line. Shifted keys ask first or are bigger.
sections.title: Keys and actions

sections.intro: w on any Home line (or Why? in the expanded line) shows the rule that matched, the facts it read, and the rules above it that did not match.
sections.title: Why is this line here?

sections.example:
# $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/lazyagent/rules.toml
version = 1

[[rule]]
id = "merge"
says = "Merge only after QA."
and_when = 'tracker.status == "QA passed"'
sections.intro: Rules are data. Your global rules.toml and a repo's .lazyagent/rules.toml can add, replace or narrow the built-ins. A bad rule is skipped and the built-in stays.
sections.title: Your rules

sections.intro: What rules can read. The engine fetches a costly fact only when an active rule reads it.
sections.title: Facts

zones.name: Now
zones.text: An agent is blocked on you: an approval, a question. Shown at once.

zones.name: Round
zones.text: Quick things that block nobody. Delivered in rounds, so nothing moves under your cursor.

zones.name: To sit down with
zones.text: Things to read: a brief, changes requested, a finished branch. Against your limit (deep_max).

zones.name: In flight
zones.text: The ball is not yours: who has it and since when. Done rows fold at its end for a day.

zones.name: Parked
zones.text: What you parked, folded until you open it (⇧Z). Says when it comes back.

kinds.sentence: The agent's status is waiting for approval
kinds.title: Needs approval

kinds.sentence: The agent's status is waiting for user
kinds.title: Question

kinds.sentence: The agent's status is possibly hanged
kinds.title: Hanged?

kinds.says: An open PR red on its head with no agent at work on it.
kinds.sentence: The PR's state is open and the PR's checks are red on its head and there are no agents at work
kinds.title: CI failing

kinds.says: A fresh red Actions run on the head of a branch with no PR (I7).
kinds.sentence: Not: there is a PR and Actions on the head is red and there are no agents at work
kinds.title: CI failed
kinds.when: not pr.exists and ci.head == "red" and agents.running == 0

kinds.sentence: The PR's state is open and the PR's review decision is changes requested
kinds.title: Changes requested

kinds.sentence: The PR's state is open and the PR's mergeability is conflicting and there are no agents at work
kinds.title: Merge conflict

kinds.says: Only when nothing else runs there and there is no PR yet; never the orchestrator, nor an agent whose report says it works on.
kinds.sentence: The agent's status is completed, waiting or interrupted and there are no agents at work and not: there is a PR and not: the orchestrator's own place and not: the agent's report says where the ball is
kinds.title: Your turn
kinds.when: agent.status in ["completed", "waiting", "interrupted"] and agents.running == 0 and not pr.exists and not place.is_orchestrator and not agent.reported

kinds.says: A linked tracker task entered a status mapped with a level (its own).
kinds.title: Tracker

kinds.says: A brief: its level and blocks_agent are the item's own.
kinds.title: Decide

The PR's state is closed

rules.says: Closing the PR stays the user's (never alone).
rules.sentence: The PR's state is open and the branch the head is already in is set
rules.state_text: already merged into ‹the branch the head is already in›

then.suggestion_expr: "close PR #" + pr.number + ": its head is in " + pr.merged_into

rules.sentence: Your gesture is close
rules.state_text: dropped by you / closed by you

rules.says: The whole work item waits in Parked, with the ball it would have.
rules.sentence: Your gesture is park

rules.says: The work item's open inbox items, top first.
rules.sentence: There are work item's open inbox items

rules.says: You passed it to the orchestrator.
rules.sentence: You passed it to the orchestrator
The orchestrator holds it

rules.says: The orchestrator holds a routed brief or question here.
rules.sentence: Who holds a routed item here is orchestrator
The delegation's phase is on it
rules.state_text: agent ‹the agent it was delegated to› · fixing (it / ‹what the agent is fixing›)

rules.sentence: Not: the inbox queue is on and the agents' statuses include waiting for approval
Not: the inbox queue is on and the agents' statuses include waiting for user
Not: the inbox queue is on and the agents' statuses include failed
Not: the inbox queue is on and the agents' statuses include possibly hanged
Not: the inbox queue is on and the agent reported it needs you

rules.says: Approved, CI green and mergeable: merging is yours, on the PR.
rules.sentence: The PR's state is open and the PR's review decision is approved and CI on the PR is green or none and the PR's mergeability is mergeable
rules.when: pr.state == "open" and pr.review == "approved" and ci.state in ["green", "none"] and pr.mergeable == "mergeable"

rules.sentence: The PR's state is open and not: the inbox queue is on and the PR's review decision is changes requested
rules.when: pr.state == "open" and not queue.enabled and pr.review == "changes_requested"

rules.sentence: The PR's state is open and not: the inbox queue is on and there are no agents at work and the PR's mergeability is conflicting
rules.when: pr.state == "open" and not queue.enabled and agents.running == 0 and pr.mergeable == "conflicting"

rules.sentence: The PR's state is open and not: the inbox queue is on and there are no agents at work and CI on the PR is red
rules.when: pr.state == "open" and not queue.enabled and agents.running == 0 and ci.state == "red"

rules.sentence: Not: the inbox queue is on and there are agents whose turn is over and there are no agents at work and not: there is a PR and the agent's reported ball is empty
rules.when: not queue.enabled and agents.idle > 0 and agents.running == 0 and not pr.exists and report.ball == ""

rules.sentence: Your gesture is label

rules.says: Never the agent's tool line ("Bash done"): that is noise on a row.
rules.sentence: There are agents at work
The PR's state is open and CI on the PR is running
The agent's reported ball is others
rules.state_text: reported: ‹the agent's reported ball› / ‹the agent's report note›

rules.says: Ball agent: it works on in the background (its turn is over).
rules.sentence: The agent's reported ball is set
rules.state_text: agent ‹the agent that reported› · (working / ‹the agent's report note›) / reported: ‹the agent's reported ball› / ‹the agent's report note›

then.state_expr: report.ball == "agent" ? clip("agent " + report.agent + " · " + (report.note == "" ? "working" : report.note), 8) : clip(report.note == "" ? "reported: " + report.ball : report.note, 5)

rules.says: Without the queue: the level while the task's entered-status item is open.
rules.sentence: The task's mapped ball is you and the task's mapped level is known and not: the inbox queue is on
rules.when: tracker.ball == "you" and known(tracker.level) and not queue.enabled

rules.sentence: The task's mapped ball is others
The task's mapped ball is not you

rules.says: Nobody was asked: that is the user's to do, not others' to wait on.
rules.sentence: The PR's state is open and the PR's review decision is review required or none and there are no PR's requested reviewers and there are no PR's reviews
rules.when: pr.state == "open" and pr.review in ["review_required", "none"] and pr.review_requests == 0 and pr.reviews == 0

rules.sentence: The PR's state is open and the PR's review decision is review required or none

rules.says: An agent still on a dialog whose item was dismissed or parked.
rules.sentence: There are agents
rules.state_text: waits: approve / waits: answer / waits: agent failed / waits: agent may hang / agent idle

then.state_expr: "waiting_for_approval" in agents.statuses ? "waits: approve" : "waiting_for_user" in agents.statuses ? "waits: answer" : "failed" in agents.statuses ? "waits: agent failed" : "possibly_hanged" in agents.statuses ? "waits: agent may hang" : "agent idle"

The time since the last sign of work is over the stalled threshold

rules.when: queue.enabled and pr.state == "open" and pr.review == "approved" and ci.state in ["green", "none"] and pr.mergeable == "mergeable"
